notes: Owner decision 2026-10-29 ("Portal link is enough"): a homeowner signs every check and document on their claim from the claim portal (the tracking link, homeowner_ledger_tokens). The accepted storage.mjs (/public/signature-document) and signature-submit.mjs (/public/signature-submit) bytes accept, besides the emailed token, the portal pair {ledger_token, signer_id}: the API resolves the signer's existing token_hash through aws_public_homeowner_document_portal_signer (SQL 127), the view with a write client in its own transaction, the submit inside its own transaction before the lookup and submit.
